description: Every detail level against one locator, and a budget truncation. The levels widen rather than reshape: summary is the head, excerpt adds a bounded body, full adds the whole body and the tags, and context adds the note's other sections — each keeping its own locator, because grouping sections into one expansion must not cost a reader the ability to expand one of them. The last request offers 96 bytes: the content is cut at a UTF-8 boundary, `truncated` is true, and `truncation_boundary` says which limit applied, so a caller can tell a budget cut from a source-side limit.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
